description: Source file implementing monitor database and node classes for managing wireless network monitoring data, including classes for radio, VAP, STA nodes, and the main monitor_db class with methods for adding, removing, and retrieving nodes, as well as operator overloads for outputting node information.

classes.name: monitor_radio_node
classes.description: Represents a radio node with statistics and methods to calculate bit rates and clear stats.

classes.name: monitor_vap_node
classes.description: Represents a VAP node with statistics, MAC address, interface info, and methods for bit rate calculation and IP retrieval.

classes.name: monitor_sta_node
classes.description: Represents a station node with statistics, RSSI, SNR, PHY rates, and methods for load calculations and poll data reset.

classes.name: monitor_db
classes.description: Main database class managing collections of VAP and STA nodes, with methods for adding, removing, retrieving nodes, and managing polling timings.

methods.name: operator<<(monitor_radio_node &)
methods.description: Outputs radio node statistics to an ostream.

methods.name: operator<<(monitor_vap_node &)
methods.description: Outputs VAP node statistics to an ostream.

methods.name: operator<<(monitor_sta_node &)
methods.description: Outputs station node statistics to an ostream.

methods.name: monitor_db::vap_add
methods.description: Adds a new VAP node to the database.

methods.name: monitor_db::vap_remove
methods.description: Removes a VAP node by ID.

methods.name: monitor_db::sta_erase
methods.description: Removes a station node by MAC address.

methods.name: monitor_db::get_bssid_list
methods.description: Retrieves list of BSSIDs from VAP nodes.
